# Gaxia API reference

Generated from the source: every function, signal, field and type listed here exists exactly as written.
If something is not on these pages, it does not exist — do not guess names.

- **[INDEX.md](INDEX.md)** — every function and signal on one line each (search it first).

## Packages

"Boot" = starts at server boot whenever it is installed.

### Data & players

| Package | Boot | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| [Data](Data.md) | yes | Player save data (ProfileService): Get / Set / Save, session locking, auto-save. |
| [Migration](Migration.md) |  | Schema versioning for saved profiles: register upgrade steps per version. |
| [Player](Player.md) | yes | Player lifecycle: joined / left signals, character helpers, leaderstats. |
| [Settings](Settings.md) | yes | Per-player settings saved in the profile, with a client remote to read and change them. |
| [Memory](Memory.md) |  | Cross-server short-lived storage over MemoryStoreService (sorted maps, queues). |
| [Messages](Messages.md) |  | Cross-server messaging over MessagingService with JSON payloads. |
| [Teleport](Teleport.md) |  | Hardened TeleportService wrapper: retries, reserved servers, teleport data. |

### Economy & items

| Package | Boot | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| [Economy](Economy.md) |  | Currencies: atomic Add / Spend / Transfer backed by Data. |
| [Item](Item.md) |  | Per-player item counts in the profile: Give / Remove / Has / Count. |
| [ItemDef](ItemDef.md) |  | Item definition registry: what every item or decoration is. |
| [Inventory](Inventory.md) |  | Deep inventory: unique item instances, stacks and equip slots. |
| [Shop](Shop.md) |  | Server-authoritative shop catalogue with soft-currency and Robux items. |
| [Monetization](Monetization.md) | yes | GamePasses and developer products with idempotent ProcessReceipt. Needed to sell developer products. |
| [Trade](Trade.md) |  | Two-party, both-confirm, atomic item and currency trading. |
| [Loot](Loot.md) |  | Weighted drop tables with saved pity. |
| [Codex](Codex.md) |  | Collection registry (Pokédex-style discovered / owned tracking). |
| [Refine](Refine.md) |  | Crafting / refining recipes, checked on the server. |
| [Vault](Vault.md) |  | Capacity-bounded secure storage (a bank). |
| [DailyReward](DailyReward.md) |  | Login-streak daily rewards. |
| [Mail](Mail.md) |  | Saved player inbox with claimable reward attachments. |
